## Tai Po Town Centre @HMA

There are 9,399 private residential units, involving 118,937 population in Tai Po Town Centre(Tai Po District).Major streets included Ting Kok Road(Tai Po Town Centre Section)、Nam Hang Village. Major estates include Wang Fuk Court,Tai Po Centre,Chung Nga Court,Fu Heng Estate,Fu Shin Estate.The median of monthly income of the district is HK$ 24,680 with a median age of 48.1.
